assets.prompt: Use case: precise-object-edit. Asset: one production-ready TRANSPARENT standard Rainbow Lantern sprite, cheerful match-3 game. Keep the round silhouette, top cap, curved base, and the small simple four-point star on Image 1. Bright and playful just like the surrounding colorful tiles; dial back only the contrast of the specular highlights and emission compared with the enhanced version. Strong contrast between cream star and bright teal-blue glass. All meaningful shapes should still be recognizable at 32 pixels. Exactly one front-facing object, centered on a square canvas, complete with transparent perimeter and genuine alpha. No gray cast, brown cast, darkness, mirror flashes, neon, little glints, glowing aura, rays, text, graphic labels, scene, or shadows outside the lantern.
